title: ACME Conductor CertificateReconcileJob v1alpha1
description: Input to one acme-runner execution. The contract carries only logical references: ASCII FQDNs only (no internationalized domain names), no secrets, no commands, images, environment variables or cloud resource identifiers. acme/dns/store are logical binding names resolved from administrator-provided configuration on the Runner side, never inline credentials or connection details. Go validation (pkg/api/v1alpha1) is authoritative and stricter than this schema; see schemas/README.md.

runId.description: Opaque run identifier (e.g. a ULID or UUID). Letters, digits, '-' and '_' only.

fqdn.description: Normalized ASCII FQDN (lower-case, no trailing dot), optionally with a leading '*.' wildcard label. This pattern only expresses the surface syntax. Semantic checks the Go code additionally enforces are NOT expressible in JSON Schema and are the authoritative rules: label-boundary suffix matching (e.g. 'evil-example.ac.jp' is not under 'example.ac.jp'), rejection of an all-numeric top-level label, rejection of 'xn--' (IDNA) labels, and that the value is already in normalized form.

revision.description: Optimistic-locking revision of the target at the time the job was created.

items.description: Normalized ASCII DNS suffix (no wildcard, no trailing dot). See target.fqdn description for the semantic checks the schema cannot express.

allowedDnsSuffixes.description: Suffixes under which a certificate may be issued. Must be non-empty; duplicates are rejected by Go validation (JSON Schema's uniqueItems catches exact-string duplicates only).

allowWildcard.description: Whether '*.name' targets are permitted. Go validation additionally cross-checks this against target.fqdn; the schema cannot express that cross-field rule.

acme.description: Administrator-registered ACME binding (directory URL, account and optional EAB reference live in Runner configuration).

binding.description: Logical name resolved from administrator-provided configuration on the Runner side. Never a credential, connection string or resource identifier.
